orders.title: Expose AccessTokenDto.issuedAt end to end
orders.goal: Add a required date-time field issuedAt (the JWT iat) to the backend AccessTokenDto and the session service, regenerate OpenAPI and both REST SDKs with `pnpm rest-api-sdk:generate`, and add a typed web consumer type AccessTokenIssuedAt = AccessTokenDto['issuedAt'] in apps/next-web-app/src/infra/client-api/types/access-token-issued-at.type.ts.
acceptance: client and admin OpenAPI AccessTokenDto declare issuedAt as a required date-time string
client and admin SDK AccessTokenDto declare issuedAt: string
committed OpenAPI/SDK outputs equal the pinned generator output (sdk-generation gate)
backend and web type checks pass
the web consumer type reads AccessTokenDto['issuedAt'] from the client SDK
